paragraphs: Lily is in bed on Monday morning. She has a cold and a cough. "I can't go to school today," she says. Mom puts a hand on her head. Her head is hot. "You are ill," says Mom. "You can sleep at home." Mom brings tea and soup. Lily is tired and a little sad. Pip is on her bed.

After school, Tom comes into her room. "I can bring you a game," he says. He has a tablet in his hand. "It's a game about animals," says Tom. He asks, "Can a dolphin fly?" "No, it can't," says Lily. "But it can swim." "Yes!" says Tom. "Here is another one. Can a fish walk?" "No, it can't!" laughs Lily, and then she coughs.

"Now a difficult one," says Tom. "Can a kangaroo swim?" Lily thinks and thinks. "A kangaroo can hop," she says. "I think it can't swim." "You are wrong!" says Tom. "A kangaroo can swim well." "Wow!" says Lily. She drinks her warm tea and smiles. Her cough is a little better. "I can't go to school, but I can learn." Pip says, "Woof!" He can't play the game, but he is happy too.
text.summary: Lily is ill at home with a cold. Tom brings a tablet, and they play a game about what animals can and can't do.
